exceptions.reason: Text Area has no aria-label/label-for mechanism in Perspective 8.3 (platform gap, same class as the already-excepted checkbox and dropdown-search inputs); the Notepad's TextArea sits under a visible 'Notepad:' label with no way to associate the two.

the alarm status table tints its own toolbar tabs and severity-coloured cells and always pairs them with a fixed text colour; a light severity swatch under dark-cool computes under 4.5:1 against that fixed text, and neither half is reachable from a project stylesheet -- verified against several live alarm mixes, the failing pair changes with whichever severity is active but the cause does not.
the alarm status table draws its own row/button focus handling with no stylesheet hook, the same platform-drawn markup already excepted for unreachable-click-target.
same cause as the no-focus-ring exception above: the ring the table draws for its own controls is not styleable from the project.

the slider handle draws a real focus indicator via box-shadow (0 0 0 5px rgba(78,188,252,.5), verified with a real keyboard Tab walk on 8.3.8, not a script .focus() call) rather than the outline property this check measures -- a tool false negative, not a missing ring.

Power Chart draws its own internal toolbar and pen-list controls with no tabindex; same category as the chart-library exceptions already built into the tool for other rules, extended here to keyboard reachability.
Power Chart's own expandable pen-list body can overflow and is drawn entirely inside the chart component, with no project hook to add tabindex to platform-internal markup.

Text Field has no aria-label/label-for mechanism in Perspective 8.3 (platform gap, same class as the already-excepted checkbox, dropdown-search and numeric-entry inputs). Every instance this project ships is a read-only status display (Settings' Database Connection / Tag Folder fields) sitting under its own visible label with no way to associate the two.

belt-and-suspenders alongside the tool's own built-in numeric-entry-field exception: that one re-queries the live page by axe's selector to find the owning component, and a handful of this project's numeric-entry-fields share identical rendered attributes (several 'OEE Target' fields default to the same value), so the re-query can land on a sibling instead of the flagged node and miss the exception. Matching the input's own distinctive class instead needs no re-query. Same platform gap: numeric-entry-field has no label association in Perspective 8.3.
same platform gap as the text-field/text-area exceptions above, on the slider handle; the OEE Target slider sits under a visible 'OEE Target' label with no aria-label mechanism to attach.

the month/year dropdowns on Production Summary draw their own expanded option list with no per-row focus styling hook from the project, the same category as the already-excepted dropdown-search input.

a bare loading placeholder inside the Perspective client shell, present only in the first couple of seconds before a page's own data streams in -- verified absent on every page at a 4s render check, so no reader ever sees it long enough to need alt text. Perspective's ia.display.image components (the two this project uses) already carry altText.
